summary: Stage 2 code and the concrete deployment plan are ready for the single authorized execution. All required pre-deployment artifacts are present and mutually consistent: pilot/seam verification and raw acceptance reports, source_samples.json with Stage 1 calibration IDs, nine passing unit tests, and a GET-only preflight plan whose eight items sum to 125830928 bytes with run 3-4 validity only in cdb_prjdatpsana/jungfrau_000010. The HTTP guard restricts mutations to one pre-hashed POST at a time on exactly two destination URLs; deploy refuses any prior attempt and re-verifies plan/script/payload hashes and unchanged destination and protected source metadata before writing. Byte verification permits only timestamp, BeginRun expt/runnum and SMD reference spans, and the pilot schedule is pinned to the frozen Stage 1 mapping. Two medium non-blocking robustness findings remain in the deploy transport (missing octet-stream Content-Type on the GridFS POST versus psana's proven path, and parsing the response as JSON before persisting it). Addressing them would change calibration.py and require re-running the GET-only prepare step. Post-deployment readback and calibrated acceptance are not yet executed and are not treated as passed.

findings.evidence: GridFS upload sends kwargs=dict(data=raw_bytes) with only KerberosTicket auth headers (line 148/168). psana's proven path (MDBWebUtils.post -> CalibConstants.krbheaders) sets Content-Type: application/octet-stream for every write; the MFX precedent used wu.add_data_and_doc. No prior repository evidence of a raw POST to /gridfs/ without that header.
findings.requested_change: Either add 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' to the GridFS POST headers (then re-run GET-only prepare so the plan's script_sha256 matches) or explicitly accept the risk that the first POST may be rejected, burning the one-shot attempt and requiring manual cleanup of the deployment directory.

findings.evidence: result=response.json() executes before save(prefix.with_suffix('.response.json'),...). A non-JSON reply (HTML 401/500, or a 3xx body since allow_redirects=False) raises before the response record is written, leaving only the intent on disk for an uncertain write.
findings.requested_change: Persist status_code, headers and response.text before JSON parsing, and require not response.is_redirect; keep the no-retry policy. If not changed now, document that an uncertain write must be reconciled by GET inspection of fs.files and the collection.

findings.evidence: A single KerberosTicket header set is reused for the privilege GET and all 16 POSTs; psana regenerates krbheaders per request. prepare() reused one header set for two GETs successfully, so reuse appears accepted, but a mid-sequence 401 would halt the deployment with a partial journal.
findings.requested_change: Optionally regenerate auth headers per request. Otherwise no change; the halt is safe and inspectable.

findings.evidence: completion.json fields pilot_bytes=5039830328, documents_deployed=8, existing_run1_2_files_unchanged=40 and source_file_stats_unchanged=14 are literals, not derived from the checked data; calibration.py verify() likewise writes post_requests=16 and existing_documents_unchanged=13 as literals.
findings.requested_change: Compute these values from the loaded generation/plan/journal/admin_checks data or assert the literals against them so the completion evidence cannot drift from what was checked.

findings.evidence: Documents use time_sec=now, run_orig=0 and tstamp_orig='' whereas the MFX precedent preserved source time_sec/time_stamp/run_orig. Run-range selection is unaffected and source provenance is retained in extpars.
findings.requested_change: No change required for this pilot; consider carrying source time_sec/time_stamp/run_orig into future documents for parity with the existing destination records.

findings.evidence: Tests cover the transport guard but not the deploy() loop itself (intent-before-POST ordering, id_data substitution, journal writing, failure after a data upload). A document POST failure after a successful GridFS POST leaves an orphan blob that the no-retry design requires to be handled manually.
findings.requested_change: Optionally add a mocked-transport test of deploy() to exercise intent/response/journal ordering and the post-failure stop; document the orphan-blob inspection procedure in README.

findings.evidence: prepare() loads SNAPSHOT/destination_calibration_before.json without checking it against the pinned destination_calibration_sha256 in the hash-verified Stage 1 admin_checks.json; it is only compared to the live destination.
findings.requested_change: Verify the snapshot file hash against frozen_report('admin_checks')['destination_calibration_sha256'] before using it as the baseline.
